name: MCLEAN
recent: MClean 于 2026 年 11 月完成私募配售，以每股 RM0.60 发行 2400 万股新股，筹资约 RM14.4 million。此前，公司于 2026 年 10 月将私募发行价定为 RM0.60。同期，执行主席 Datuk Dr Terence Tea Yeok Kian 间接持股的 Accrelist Crowdfunding 在场外出售 3000 万股，持股比例降至 16.356%。
notable: 完成私募配售，以每股 RM0.60 发行 2400 万股新股，于 2026 年 11 月 11 日上市。
执行主席 Datuk Dr Terence Tea Yeok Kian 间接持股的 Accrelist Crowdfunding 在场外出售 3000 万股，持股比例降至 16.356%。
2026 年 10 月 30 日将私募发行价定为每股 RM0.60，较 5 日成交量加权平均价折价约 4.66%。
risks: 私募配售发行 2400 万股新股，占扩大后股本约 8.9%，对现有股东持股比例产生摊薄影响。
执行主席间接持股的 Accrelist Crowdfunding 在场外出售 3000 万股，持股比例下降。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度营收为 RM20.117 million，环比增长 8.9%，同比增长 14.2%；净利润为 RM3.859 million，环比增长 21.1%，同比增长 36.3%；净利润率为 19.2%，高于上一季度的 17.3%。

recent_en: MClean completed a private placement in November 2026, issuing 24 million new shares at RM0.60 each, raising approximately RM14.4 million. Earlier, the company fixed the placement price at RM0.60 in October 2026. Meanwhile, Accrelist Crowdfunding, in which Executive Chairman Datuk Dr Terence Tea Yeok Kian has an indirect interest, sold 30 million shares off-market, reducing its stake to 16.356%.
notable_en: Completed a private placement of 24 million new shares at RM0.60 each, listed on 11 November 2026.
Accrelist Crowdfunding, in which Executive Chairman Datuk Dr Terence Tea Yeok Kian has an indirect interest, sold 30 million shares off-market, reducing its stake to 16.356%.
Fixed the private placement issue price at RM0.60 per share on 30 October 2026, a discount of about 4.66% to the 5-day volume weighted average market price.
risks_en: The private placement of 24 million new shares represents about 8.9% of the enlarged share capital, diluting existing shareholders' stakes.
Accrelist Crowdfunding, in which the Executive Chairman has an indirect interest, sold 30 million shares off-market, reducing its shareholding.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM20.117 million, up 8.9% QoQ and 14.2% YoY; net income was RM3.859 million, up 21.1% QoQ and 36.3% YoY; net margin was 19.2%, up from 17.3% in the previous quarter.
